question: Which of the following books is an autobiography of the Indian politician LK Advani?

options.text: In Pursuit of Justice: An Autobiography

solution:
The correct answer is __**My Country My Life**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **autobiography** of the Indian politician L.K. Advani is titled **"My Country, My Life" **
 
• This insightful and assertive account chronicles Advani’s fight for democracy during the Emergency
 
• Lal Krishna Advani is a politician of the Bhartiya Janta Party.
 
 
• He served as the Deputy Prime Minister of India from 2002 to 2004.
 
• He was also the Leader of the Opposition in the 15th Lok Sabha.
 
• The book was released in 2008 by APJ Abdul Kalam.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wings of Fire: An Autobiography **

 
 
• **​It** is the autobiography of A.P.J Abdul Kalam.
 
• He was the 11th President of India.
 
• He served as the President of India from 2002 to 2007
 
• He is the first scientist to become the President of India.
 
 
 
• **My Times: An Autobiography**
 
 
• **​**My Times: An Autobiography” is a brilliant literary work by **J.B. Kripalani**
 
• He is also known as **Acharya Kripalani.**
 
• In this extensive autobiography, **Kripalani unveils his life, experiences, and observations on the Indian political scene**
 
 
 
• **In Pursuit of Justice: An Autobiography **
 
 
• **It ​**is a remarkable literary work by J**ustice Rajindar Sachar****. **
 
• This autobiography **illuminates the impactful life of an extraordinary individual who shaped India’s legal and social fabric.**
 
 

c0:T
